name: Microwave Oven Production Line Solution
summary: A complete line automation solution for microwave oven manufacturers, covering the entire process of cavity assembly, door assembly, electrical wiring, and final inspection and packaging.
contentHtml:
The microwave oven production line solution is a complete line automation solution provided by TXAM for home appliance manufacturers.

Solution Composition

The entire line covers the full process including cavity assembly, door assembly, microwave generator installation, magnetron installation, electrical wiring, and final inspection and packaging.

Solution Advantages

  • High degree of line automation
  • Multi-model flexible production
  • Automated inspection ensures quality and safety
  • Efficient packaging system
  • Turnkey project service

Service Content

Provides full-process support including line planning, equipment manufacturing, installation and commissioning, and after-sales service.
